text: Not sure of the location. this is nothing but a hooch but not sure where this would be. Had to be in our company area. We had maybe 10 hooches and a big BBQ'ing area with steaks. 24 hours a day you could get a steak and cook it and they were good steaks
researchNotes: Unsure where the frame was, so no place is set on the photograph. The ten hooches and the round-the-clock steak barbecue describe the company area and were told at this photograph, not about it.
